class.name: ListAdapter
class.brief_description: Adapter backed by an Array that auto-diffs on submit_list().
class.description:
ListAdapter wraps a plain Array and a [b]DiffUtilItemCallback[/b]. Calling [method submit_list] diffs the current list against the new one and dispatches the incremental updates to any attached RecyclerView automatically, so only real changes are animated. [method _get_item_count] is provided by this class; subclasses implement [method Adapter._create_item] / [method Adapter._bind_item] and read their data through [method get_item].
[b]Setup[/b]: [codeblock] var adapter := MyListAdapter.new() adapter.set_diff_callback(MyDiffCallback.new()) recycler_view.set_adapter(adapter) # later, on data change: adapter.submit_list(new_items) [/codeblock] where [code]MyDiffCallback[/code] extends [b]DiffUtilItemCallback[/b] and implements [method DiffUtilItemCallback._are_items_the_same] / [method DiffUtilItemCallback._are_contents_the_same].

method.name: _on_current_list_changed
method.description: Called after a successful [method submit_list], with the previous and current lists.

method.name: get_item
method.description: Returns the item at [code]index[/code], or null when out of range.

method.name: set_diff_callback
method.description: Sets the [b]DiffUtilItemCallback[/b] used to compare items when submitting a new list.

method.name: submit_list
method.description: Diffs the current list against [code]list[/code] and dispatches incremental updates. Passing the same array instance is a no-op. The diff runs synchronously.
